subject: Retention package authorization: Aaron Cho (UX Lead)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention package authorization: Aaron Cho (UX Lead)

Folks —

Quick ask: Aaron Cho (UX Lead candidate, final onsite last week) has received an external counteroffer this morning from his current employer (PixelWave) and is asking for a more competitive package to join Redwood. Hiring manager says high impact (platform UX for inference console) and a shorter ramp. I want to request an exception to the published comp band to close.

Proposed exception (one-time top-up + equity refresh + small base uplift):
- Base: increase from band midpoint offer of $180,000 to $195,000 (additional $15k)
- One-time sign-on bonus: $30,000 (paid over 2 installments: 30/70 within first 12 months)
- Equity: additional 2,000 RSUs as a retention refresh (on top of standard grant)

Rationale:
- Candidate is actively being countered; losing him delays key experience work on Console metrics and inference UX by a quarter.
- Market comps for senior UX leads in SF bay indicate offers ~200-220k base + refreshes.
- Candidate indicated Redwood is first choice but needs a tangible retention signal.

Attached: offer_summary_Aaron_Cho_v2.pdf and comp_band_reference.xlsx (shows band and where this sits).

Budget owner: Product org (Marissa), headcount is approved for Q2 (open req RI-9876). Will need finance/legal sign-off for the change in equity and sign-on terms.

Requesting approval or counter-proposal by EOD tomorrow (Thu 4/15) so we can get the DocuSign ready.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention package authorization: Aaron Cho (UX Lead)

Ben —

Thanks for the context and attachments. A few clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Can you confirm the hiring manager (PM) sign-off that the 2,000 RSU refresh is necessary vs. an accelerated vesting schedule?
2) Who is the budget owner for the additional $15k base (Product or People Ops)?
3) Candidate's actual competing counteroffer details (total comp) — need to evaluate gap.

Initial reaction: I am sympathetic given the product impact, but I'd prefer to limit the cash sign-on. Suggest we consider $20k sign-on + 1,500 RSU refresh and move base to $190k. That keeps us closer to band while still showing meaningful movement. If this is still at risk, escalate to Lauren for exception.

Soojin — please confirm we have runway under the product budget for the uplift. Lauren — if Marissa and I escalate, are you available for a quick decision tomorrow?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product, Console
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention package authorization: Aaron Cho (UX Lead)

Marissa —

Answers inline and additional context from hiring manager:
1) Hiring manager (Eve Turner) prefers RSUs vs. accelerating vesting because candidate has signaled retention concern beyond first 12 months. RSU refresh gives a clearer retention signal.
2) Product (Marissa's org) will cover base uplift + equity top-up; sign-on will be split 50/50 between Product and People Operations (per prior ad-hoc rule for retention).
3) Competing package from PixelWave: $190k base, $25k discretionary retention bonus, and an offer to match total equity (estimated ~1,800 RSUs) with accelerated vesting. Candidate has verbally asked us to show leadership flexibility.

If Product is comfortable with Marissa's counter (190k base, $20k sign-on, 1,500 RSUs), we can present that immediately. Candidate did say he prefers Redwood but needs a response today or tomorrow latest.

Attached again: updated offer summary with redlines.

Ben

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention package authorization: Aaron Cho (UX Lead)

All —

Thanks for the clear write-up. I approve a revised package to settle quickly with the following firm limits:
- Base: $195,000 (one-time uplift approved)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (paid 50% at hire, 50% at 12 months)
- Equity refresh: 1,800 RSUs as a retention top-up

Conditions:
- RSU refresh vests over 4 years standard schedule; include a 12-month clawback clause if the candidate leaves within 12 months.
- People Ops to prepare an amended offer letter and updated cap table impact note; Legal to review standard clawback language.
- Finance to confirm budget realignment (Product covers base + equity, People Ops covers half of sign-on).

Ben — please queue DocuSign with these terms and coordinate verbally with Aaron today. If Aaron counters further on cash beyond $25k, escalate back to me.

Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
